name: Toriano
desc: The big city: a marble cathedral bristling with spires, a glass-roofed arcade, old orange trams and canals full of bars, all in the fog.

meter.name: La Sera di Toriano
meter.about: Toriano's evening paper measures you in column inches. Vale Meroni, its junior reporter, writes up every request you finish here, and big jobs make big stories. The Sindaco's approval rating stays back in Monteforchetta.

milestones.title: A notice on page 18
milestones.desc: "New Geometra in town." Four lines under the crossword. The paper sends you the city's streetlight plans to go with it.

milestones.title: Your photo in the paper
milestones.desc: A photo with a caption: you, a plank and a pigeon. The paper pays for the picture. (The winter coat and scarf to go with it come with the city's outfits.)

milestones.title: An interview, half a page
milestones.desc: "The Geometra on Toriano: lovely city, terrible toilets." Ragioniere Sala reads it too, and the bathroom plans arrive the next morning.

milestones.title: Your own weekly column
milestones.desc: "The Geometra Answers": readers' building questions, every Thursday. Your roof terrace at number 14 grows along the whole back wing.

milestones.title: On the radio
milestones.desc: Radio Naviglio interviews you live. They send a portable radio for your flat, so you can hear yourself on the repeat.

milestones.title: The front page, on Christmas Day
milestones.desc: The Golden Angel shines over the square, and your name is under the headline. Vale gets her promotion, and the framed front page hangs in your flat.
